bibl.title: A Repaid Loan from Heron to Heron: P.Mich. inv. 1330
bibl.seg: Donald Sells, A Repaid Loan from Heron to Heron: P.Mich. inv. 1330.
bibl.note: Theadelpheia, 11 March 105 CE (date of the loan), 9 July 106 CE (date of repayment). Edition of a repaid loan from 105 CE (P.Mich. inv. 1330). This is the earliest document in a small archive of papers relating to the herdsman Heron, son of Hermas.
